action_definitions.required: Visible metadata explicitly asserts a specific outstanding recipient step or preparation, with applicability supported by visible status. A due date, renewal word, cancelled event or document type alone is insufficient.
action_definitions.not_required: Visible metadata explicitly records completion, closure, automatic settled processing, or an informational/optional item without a requested step. This clears only this visible request, not all real-world obligations.
action_definitions.uncertain: Outstandingness or applicability is absent, tentative, conditional-unresolved, conflicting, historical without current status, or only suggested by a topic, sender or filename. Do not guess either obligation or clearance.

relevance_definition: Household relevance is independent of urgency and action. Household-specific informational records remain relevant. Explicit public promotions/digests are irrelevant. Generic meetings/documents have uncertain household relevance.
domain_definition: Use only an existing category/child justified by visible topic. Null domain denotes unknown truth, not a new taxonomy category. Correct classification requires both category and child.
calendar_caveat: Confirmed conditional preparation can support required; cancelled status cancels that event-specific preparation. Tentative status leaves it unresolved. Cancellation with a new explicitly pending replacement choice is still required. Calendar membership alone proves no household relevance.
drive_caveat: Generated workflow titles that explicitly assert a missing recipient submission can support a metadata-only required label. Filenames, PDF MIME type, draft options, deletion and generic billing titles cannot establish an obligation. Labels judge the visible assertion, not authenticity or current external account state.
historical_caveat: occurred_at is provenance time. Old uncompleted requests are uncertain, not automatically required or settled. Explicit completed historical records are not_required. Event start/end are separate metadata fields.
annotation_policy: Rationales and evidence references are short evaluation-side adjudications, never inference input or hidden content. Ambiguous action truth is always uncertain; no private body, balance, consent, account ownership or recipient resolution is invented.
split_protocol: Predeclared deterministic assignment; no random seed or accuracy-based selection. Development has 20 cases per action; holdout has 10. Counterfactual families stay wholly in one split. Holdout is final-evaluation-only, never instructions, examples, tuning or development error feedback.
freeze_policy: Freeze fixture contents, split assignment, annotations and rubric together on reviewed merge. Any later edit requires a new dataset/rubric version as appropriate, explicit changelog, new manifest and lock, and acknowledgement that prior holdout comparability is invalidated.
limitations: Git-tracked synthetic holdout is a procedural holdout, not blinded, representative or a production quality estimate. Counterfactual siblings are correlated. English-only cases emphasize action; relevance is not balanced and not all taxonomy children are represented. Synthetic declarations are not real-data detectors.
